title: openRound (client → server)
description: Facilitator only. Opens a masked voting round on the chosen features (FR-018). Refused with SESSION_NOT_STARTED while the session is in preparation, FEATURE_IN_OPEN_ROUND if a feature is already in an OPEN round, INVALID_MESSAGE for an unknown feature, or when `previousRoundId` is not a REVEALED round or a feature is not one of its features (FR-022).
